name: Shiva Temple, Ramchandrapur
town_description: Bihar Sharif is the headquarters of Nalanda district and one of Bihar's oldest cities, known for the ruins of the Odantapuri monastery, medieval Sufi dargahs, and its closeness to the ancient university of Nalanda. Ramchandrapur is a residential locality within the city. The area mixes older mohalla neighbourhoods with newer colonies around the Nalanda corridor.
